title: HPS: Hard Preference Sampling for Human Preference Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as a sub-component of overall model safety. Human annotators and an LLM-as-a-judge (Qwen-2.5-Instruct) score model responses on a 1-5 Likert scale based on whether they successfully avoid harmful, biased, or inappropriate content. The paper also measures general alignment using automated safety-aligned reward models to compute reward margins on safety datasets (HH-RLHF and PKU-SafeRLHF).
